features.text: SWING ASSIST MECHANISM: Promotes normal gait and muscle re-education for post-surgical recovery.
PNEUMATIC COMPRESSION BLADDER: Adjustable air support system relieves pain and stabilizes weak ligaments.
MULTI-LIGAMENT PROTECTION: Designed for ACL, MCL, LCL, and meniscus repair recovery.
GAIT CORRECTION SUPPORT: Addresses quadriceps avoidance and arthrogenic inhibition for proper leg motion.
LIGHTWEIGHT REHAB FRAME: Durable yet comfortable construction allows full-day wear.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.

indications: ACL, MCL, LCL, and Meniscus injuries or surgeries
